apply_reason: Strong technical skills and projects outweigh formal experience gap.
summary: Gaurav possesses exceptional technical skills in modern AI/ML, LLMs, and MLOps, demonstrated through an impressive project portfolio. While formal experience is slightly below the stated range, his practical applications are highly relevant and advanced.
cv_match_notes: Excellent proficiency in Python, industry-standard AI/ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, HuggingFace), MLOps (MLflow, W&B, Docker, CI/CD), and cloud basics. Projects like 'Real-Time Fraud Monitoring' and 'Healthcare AI Assistant' directly address JD requirements for predictions from historical data and unstructured data processing. strategy: Highlight relevant projects and open-source contributions to demonstrate practical experience and advanced capabilities beyond formal job titles.
